name: Astral : VR Edition
summary:
Astral: VR Edition is a sandbox about exploration and freedom. Its central mechanic is astral projection: leaving your body to explore the world from a new perspective and interact with what’s around you.

The game includes three ways to play:

Sandbox – Open-world freeplay with money and shops.

Free Build – Unlimited items and full creative freedom.

Drive – Focused on vehicles, with cars spawning at the Boot and Rusty Nail shop.

Vehicles can be bought with in-game currency or spawned freely in Free Buil
